get.summary:
Lists the alerts for a space in the account identified by the given ID.
Alerts are scoped per collection, sorted by last_firing_at (most recent first),
and may be paginated (a space can have many collections).
Required permissions:
- read:serverless_spaces

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the account (in GUID format).
This is a required field.

parameters.name: spaceId
parameters.description:
The identifier for the space (in GUID format).
This space should be part of the provided account.
This is a required field.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description:
Optional alert-state filter. If omitted (empty), alerts in ALL states are
returned; if set, only alerts in that state are returned.

 - SPACE_ALERT_STATE_UNSPECIFIED: The alert state is unspecified.
 - SPACE_ALERT_STATE_FIRING: The alert is currently firing.
 - SPACE_ALERT_STATE_RESOLVED: The alert has been resolved by the backend.

parameters.name: collectionName
parameters.description: Exact collection name. Returns alerts for that collection only.

parameters.name: collectionNameContains
parameters.description:
Case-insensitive substring matched against collection names.
Returns alerts for every collection whose name contains this value.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description:
Maximum number of alerts to return.
If not specified, all matching items are returned.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description:
A page token, received from a previous call.
Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.
When paginating, all other parameters provided to the request must match
the call that provided the page token.

get.summary:
Gets the inference token usage metrics for a space.
Metrics are aggregated per collection and may be paginated (a space can have many collections).
Provide `inference_model_id` to limit the response to a single model.
Required permissions:
- read:serverless_spaces

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the account (in GUID format).
This is a required field.

parameters.name: spaceId
parameters.description:
The identifier for the space (in GUID format).
This space should be part of the provided account.
This is a required field.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description:
Optional start time for the inference metrics query.
If omitted, defaults to 7 days ago.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description:
Optional end time for the inference metrics query.
If omitted, defaults to current time.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description:
Optional aggregation interval for histogram buckets.

 - INFERENCE_METRICS_INTERVAL_UNSPECIFIED: Interval is unspecified; defaults to DAY.
 - INFERENCE_METRICS_INTERVAL_DAY: Buckets are aggregated per day.
 - INFERENCE_METRICS_INTERVAL_WEEK: Buckets are aggregated per week.
 - INFERENCE_METRICS_INTERVAL_MONTH: Buckets are aggregated per month.

parameters.name: inferenceModelId
parameters.description: Optional identifier for a specific inference model to filter metrics by.

parameters.name: collectionName
parameters.description: Exact collection name. Returns metrics for that collection only.

parameters.name: collectionNameContains
parameters.description:
Case-insensitive substring matched against collection names.
Returns metrics for every collection whose name contains this value.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description:
Maximum number of collection metrics to return.
If not specified, all matching items are returned.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description:
A page token, received from a previous call.
Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.
When paginating, all other parameters provided to the request must match
the call that provided the page token.

get.summary:
Gets the detailed usage metrics (as timeseries) of a space in the account identified by the given ID.
Metrics are aggregated per collection and may be paginated (a space can have many collections).
Required permissions:
- read:serverless_spaces

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the account (in GUID format).
This is a required field.

parameters.name: spaceId
parameters.description:
The identifier for the space (in GUID format).
This space should be part of the provided account.
This is a required field.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description:
Optional start time for the metrics query.
If omitted, defaults to 1 hour ago.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description:
Optional end time for the metrics query.
If omitted, defaults to current time.

parameters.name: aggregator
parameters.description:
Aggregation function to apply to the time series data.
If omitted, defaults to SUM.

 - AGGREGATOR_UNSPECIFIED: Unspecified aggregation function.
 - AGGREGATOR_SUM: SUM aggregation function.
 - AGGREGATOR_AVG: AVG aggregation function.
 - AGGREGATOR_MAX: MAX aggregation function.
 - AGGREGATOR_MIN: MIN aggregation function.

parameters.name: collectionName
parameters.description: Exact collection name. Returns metrics for that collection only.

parameters.name: collectionNameContains
parameters.description:
Case-insensitive substring matched against collection names.
Returns metrics for every collection whose name contains this value.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description:
Maximum number of collection metrics to return.
If not specified, all matching items are returned.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description:
A page token, received from a previous call.
Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.
When paginating, all other parameters provided to the request must match
the call that provided the page token.

v1Aggregator.description:
Aggregator defines how metrics should be aggregated over time.

 - AGGREGATOR_UNSPECIFIED: Unspecified aggregation function.
 - AGGREGATOR_SUM: SUM aggregation function.
 - AGGREGATOR_AVG: AVG aggregation function.
 - AGGREGATOR_MAX: MAX aggregation function.
 - AGGREGATOR_MIN: MIN aggregation function.

InferenceMetricsInterval defines the histogram bucket size for inference metrics.

 - INFERENCE_METRICS_INTERVAL_UNSPECIFIED: Interval is unspecified; defaults to DAY.
 - INFERENCE_METRICS_INTERVAL_DAY: Buckets are aggregated per day.
 - INFERENCE_METRICS_INTERVAL_WEEK: Buckets are aggregated per week.
 - INFERENCE_METRICS_INTERVAL_MONTH: Buckets are aggregated per month.

v1ListSpaceAlertsResponse.description: ListSpaceAlertsResponse is the response from the ListSpaceAlerts function.

value.description: Numerical value of the metric at the given timestamp.

id.description:
Stable identifier for this firing instance (in GUID format).
Re-firing a previously-resolved alert produces a new ID.

severity.description: Severity tier, derived server-side from the alert type.

lastFiringAt.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent firing observation for this instance.

state.description:
The state of this alert. Always populated so callers can tell each row's
state apart when the request applies no state filter.

collectionName.description: Name of the collection this alert relates to.

v1SpaceAlert.description: SpaceAlert is a single alert instance for a collection in a space.

v1SpaceAlertSeverity.description:
SpaceAlertSeverity is the tier used by the UI to render badge color and announce severity to
assistive tech. Color alone never conveys severity - clients must render the label.

 - SPACE_ALERT_SEVERITY_UNSPECIFIED: Default / fallback tier. Also what an alert type that is not yet mapped resolves to;
there is intentionally no separate UNKNOWN value.
 - SPACE_ALERT_SEVERITY_INFO: Informational severity.
 - SPACE_ALERT_SEVERITY_WARNING: Warning severity.
 - SPACE_ALERT_SEVERITY_CRITICAL: Critical severity.

v1SpaceAlertState.description:
SpaceAlertState mirrors the backend state of a space alert. It is used both as
the optional request-side filter AND echoed per row on the SpaceAlert response.

 - SPACE_ALERT_STATE_UNSPECIFIED: The alert state is unspecified.
 - SPACE_ALERT_STATE_FIRING: The alert is currently firing.
 - SPACE_ALERT_STATE_RESOLVED: The alert has been resolved by the backend.

v1SpaceAlertType.description:
SpaceAlertType is the category of a space alert. Mirrors the backend alert types.

 - SPACE_ALERT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: The alert type is unspecified.
 - SPACE_ALERT_TYPE_COLLECTION_STORAGE_OVERUTILIZED: Collection storage usage is over the configured size threshold.
 - SPACE_ALERT_TYPE_TOO_MANY_COLLECTIONS: The space has too many collections.
 - SPACE_ALERT_TYPE_SPACE_API_KEY_ABOUT_TO_EXPIRE: A space API key is about to expire.
 - SPACE_ALERT_TYPE_SPACE_UNHEALTHY: The serverless space is unhealthy.
